fusions.name: Scent-Marked
fusions.desc: A lunge on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, with a 35% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Closing the Gap
fusions.desc: Uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times the damage they had left to this blow, which deals 20 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Bull Rush
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Weakest of the Herd
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage. Your armour rises by 5%.
